svg.desc: USB-C entry, PD sink and the 5 V / 3.3 V rails.
svg.text: Power corner - USB-C, CH224K PD, AP63200 buck
USB-C entry, PD sink and the 5 V / 3.3 V rails.
Component side, viewed from above. Pads shown are solder-mask openings. Generated from canary.kicad_pcb.

text.tspan: VBUS_RAW — USB-C VBUS, before the PTC
VCC_5V — 5 V rail, after the PTC

svg.text: DC volts: 4.70 - 5.25 V; must be within 100 mV of P1 at idle

text.tspan: PD_VDD — CH224K supply, fed through R106 1k

svg.text: DC volts: logic level, stable; note which level a good board shows [predicted, never measured]
oscilloscope: SW2 waveform offset up by ~4.5 - 5 V
ground reference: clip every system-side ground lead here and nowhere else

text.tspan: VCC_3V3 — 3.3 V at the inductor output

svg.text: DC volts: same as P3 within 20 mV
